nodes.description: cvCollectibles.creator - privileged address set to deployer in the constructor, used by takeOwnership
cvCollectibles._tokenIds - Counters.Counter used to derive the next ERC1155 token id
cvCollectibles._name - collection name returned by name()
ERC1155._balances - mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => uint256)) token balances
ERC1155._operatorApprovals - mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) operator approvals
ERC1155._uri - base metadata URI for all token types
Ownable._owner - contract owner controlling onlyOwner functions, also reachable via takeOwnership
NativeMetaTransaction.nonces - mapping(address => uint256) replay-protection nonces
EIP712Base.domainSeperator - EIP-712 domain hash used for signature verification
Initializable.inited - one-shot initializer flag for _initializeEIP712
collectionFactoryV1._contractname - factory display name
collectionFactoryV1._uri - base URI used to build collection URIs
FactoryInterface.collectionsList - array of deployed/added collection addresses
FactoryInterface.collectionToIndex - collection address to array index
FactoryInterface.collectionToId - collection address to collection id
FactoryInterface.idToCollection - collection id to collection address
cvCollectibles constructor: sets _name, _uri, EIP-712 domain and creator = msg.sender
cvCollectibles.name() view returning _name
cvCollectibles.takeOwnership() - allows creator to re-take ownership via transferOwnership(creator)
cvCollectibles.setURI(string) onlyOwner - updates collection base URI
cvCollectibles.mint(address,uint256,bytes) onlyOwner - increments counter and mints new token id
cvCollectibles._msgSender override delegating to ContextMixin.msgSender for meta-tx support
cvCollectibles.isApprovedForAll override whitelisting a hardcoded OpenSea proxy address
ERC1155.safeTransferFrom - transfers a single token type and calls receiver acceptance check
ERC1155.safeBatchTransferFrom - batched transfer with acceptance check
ERC1155._mint internal - credits balances and triggers acceptance check
ERC1155._doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck - external call to onERC1155Received
ERC1155._doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck - external call to onERC1155BatchReceived
Ownable.transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner - changes _owner
Ownable.renounceOwnership() onlyOwner - sets _owner to address(0)
NativeMetaTransaction.executeMetaTransaction - verifies signature, bumps nonce and self-calls payload
NativeMetaTransaction.verify - ecrecover based signer validation over EIP-712 typed hash
ContextMixin.msgSender - reads appended address from msg.data when msg.sender == address(this)
EIP712Base._initializeEIP712 - initializer guarded domain separator setup
collectionFactoryV1.launchCollection - deploys a cvCollectibles, registers it and hands ownership to caller
collectionFactoryV1.addCollection(address,uint256) onlyOwner - registers an existing collection
collectionFactoryV1.setBaseURI(string) onlyOwner - updates factory base URI
collectionFactoryV1.collectionURI - builds per-collection metadata URI
NativeMetaTransaction.getNonce - returns current nonce of a user
ERC1155.balanceOf - reads _balances for an account and id
Ownable.owner() - returns _owner, used by onlyOwner guard
collectionFactoryV1.getCollectionsCount - returns collectionsList length
ERC1155.setApprovalForAll - grants/revokes operator approval for the caller
ERC1155._mintBatch internal - batch minting with per-id balance credits
msg.sender read in cvCollectibles constructor to set creator
msg.sender compared against creator in takeOwnership
msg.sender used in launchCollection for event emission and ownership handoff
msg.sender read inside ContextMixin.msgSender
msg.sender (relayer) used in executeMetaTransaction event emission
takeOwnership invokes transferOwnership(creator), a privileged ownership state change
launchCollection calls newCollection.transferOwnership(msg.sender) on the freshly deployed contract
new cvCollectibles(uri,_name) contract creation inside launchCollection
nonces[userAddress] = nonces[userAddress].add(1) SafeMath arithmetic on nonce state
address(this).call(abi.encodePacked(functionSignature,userAddress)) low-level arbitrary self-call
ecrecover on EIP-712 typed message hash inside verify
SafeMath.sub on sender _balances during transfer/mint
SafeMath.add crediting receiver _balances during transfer/mint
External call to IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155Received / onERC1155BatchReceived on recipient contract

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as cvCollectibles.creator in the constructor
constructor writes the deployer address into creator
constructor calls _initializeEIP712(name_)
constructor calls _setURI(uri_) which writes _uri
constructor assigns _name = name_
takeOwnership is gated only by msg.sender == creator
takeOwnership unconditionally calls transferOwnership(creator)
ownership handoff enters Ownable.transferOwnership
transferOwnership mutates the _owner privileged state variable
newOwner parameter is written into _owner
uri_ parameter flows into setURI
setURI updates the shared _uri state variable
_to parameter flows into mint
_quantity parameter flows into mint
_data parameter flows into mint
_tokenIds.increment() performs counter arithmetic on state
_tokenIds.current() is assigned to local newItemId
newItemId is passed as the id argument of _mint
mint calls the internal ERC1155._mint
_mint credits _balances[id][account]
cvCollectibles._msgSender delegates to ContextMixin.msgSender
msg.sender is read inside ContextMixin.msgSender
resolved sender is assigned to the local sender variable
executeMetaTransaction builds the typed hash from domainSeperator
nonce increment arithmetic tied to replay protection state
signature verification must pass before the payload is executed
verify relies on ecrecover to derive the signer
userAddress is the expected signer passed into verify
domainSeperator feeds toTypedMessageHash inside verification
meta transaction execution performs an arbitrary self-call with attacker influenced calldata
relayer msg.sender is emitted in MetaTransactionExecuted
functionSignature is appended to the low-level call payload
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into _owner
isApprovedForAll falls back to reading _operatorApprovals
safeTransferFrom authorizes the caller through the overridable isApprovedForAll
safeTransferFrom debits and credits _balances
SafeMath.sub applied to sender balance state
SafeMath.add applied to receiver balance state
batched transfer loops over _balances updates
safeTransferFrom ends with an external receiver acceptance call
onERC1155Received gives the recipient contract control and can re-enter safeTransferFrom
safeBatchTransferFrom ends with an external batch acceptance call
onERC1155BatchReceived can re-enter safeBatchTransferFrom
_mint triggers the single-token acceptance check on the receiver
balanceOf reads _balances[id][account]
account parameter flows into balanceOf
id parameter flows into balanceOf
owner() reads _owner and is the basis of the onlyOwner guard
mint is restricted by onlyOwner which reads owner()
setApprovalForAll writes _operatorApprovals for the caller
attacker supplied collection_id is used directly as the idToCollection key
_name parameter is forwarded to the new collection constructor
launchCollection writes idToCollection guarded only by an address(0) check
launchCollection builds the token URI via collectionURI
uri local produced by collectionURI is used for deployment
launchCollection triggers the creation of a new cvCollectibles
address of the created contract is stored in local _collection
collectionToId mapping is written with the new collection
idToCollection mapping is written with the new collection
collectionToIndex is written with the list length
new collection address is pushed into collectionsList
msg.sender of launchCollection receives ownership of the deployed collection
launchCollection hands the new collection over to the caller
transferOwnership is invoked on the freshly deployed collection
collection_id indexes factory mappings in addCollection
_collection parameter flows into addCollection
newURI parameter flows into setBaseURI
setBaseURI assigns the factory _uri used to build collection URIs
name() returns _contractname
getCollectionsCount reads collectionsList length

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as an argument of cvCollectibles.mint
_quantity is only meaningful as an argument of cvCollectibles.mint
_data is just the receiver payload forwarded by cvCollectibles.mint
uri_ is only used to update the URI state of cvCollectibles.setURI
collection_id is only consumed inside launchCollection
_name is only forwarded to the collection constructor from launchCollection
_collection is only used to register a collection in addCollection
collection_id is only used to index mappings inside addCollection
newOwner is only meaningful as the argument of transferOwnership
userAddress is only meaningful within executeMetaTransaction and its verification
functionSignature is only used to build the self-call and hash in the meta transaction
newURI is only used to overwrite the factory base URI
account is only a lookup key for ERC1155.balanceOf
id is only a lookup key for ERC1155.balanceOf
newItemId is the id passed straight into the internal mint
uri is a transient value consumed when launching the collection
_collection is the address resulting from the contract creation operation
the MetaTransaction struct exists only to feed the low-level self-call path
sender is the locally resolved value returned by ContextMixin.msgSender
